user_query: I want to impress my colleagues at the office with some trivia. Give me a random fact using a number between 10 and 20. Additionally, find an album on Deezer that features various genres and has received positive reviews.

TaskList.description: Generate a random number between 10 and 20 to select a trivia fact.
Retrieve a trivia fact associated with the generated number.
Search for an album on Deezer that features various genres and has positive reviews.
